moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: "China has prospered immensely" under Xi, calling him a "great leader."
moments.why: Because Musk’s praise for Xi in a CCTV interview is politically explosive and dominating tech‑business conversations.

moments.author: Sridhar Vembu
moments.quote: I tell our engineers to use AI but never cede our understanding to AI. As an industry, we are driving too fast… inviting disaster.
moments.why: It’s tapping into the deep anxiety and debate among male professionals about AI’s role in software engineering.

moments.author: Alexander Zverev
moments.quote: “Trinity, I thought you had a game today… You’re the lucky charm, not today, but usually.”
moments.why: A playful post‑match shout‑out to Trinity Rodman—mixing sports and romance—went absurdly viral among sports fans.
